narration: You are born in a floating raft of eggs, drifting at the surface of the open ocean.
scene: A jelly raft of many tiny round eggs floating on a simple ocean surface
label: OPEN OCEAN

narration: Your mother is already a thousand meters below you.
scene: Tiny eggs at the top of the frame, a long arrow pointing down to a small female anglerfish far below
label: 1,000 METERS DOWN

narration: And she is not coming back.
scene: A female anglerfish swimming away, leaving an egg raft behind
label: SHE'S GONE

narration: She dumped tens of thousands of you in a jelly raft, then swam away.
scene: A big jelly blob packed with thousands of tiny eggs, mother swimming off
label: JELLY RAFT

narration: You are not special. You are a number.
scene: One tiny egg highlighted among thousands with an arrow pointing at it
label: NOT SPECIAL

narration: You hatch at the size of a grain of rice.
scene: A tiny larval fish next to an actual grain of rice for scale
label: GRAIN OF RICE

narration: You look nothing like the monster on the thumbnail.
scene: Cute tiny larval fish looking confused at a scary adult anglerfish with a lure
label: NOT YET

narration: No fishing rod. No fangs. No light.
scene: Tiny larva beside three crossed-out icons: a fishing rod, fangs, and a lightbulb
label: NOTHING

narration: Just a speck with a will to live.
scene: A tiny determined larval fish alone in empty water
label: A SPECK

narration: Congratulations. You're alive. For now.
scene: Tiny larva giving a small wave, simple and funny-scary
label: FOR NOW

narration: Everything in the sunlit water wants to eat you.
scene: Tiny larva surrounded by bigger fish, a bird, and a jellyfish all looking hungry
label: EVERYONE EATS YOU

narration: Fish. Birds. Even jellyfish.
scene: Three simple doodles in a row: a fish, a bird, a jellyfish
label: FISH. BIRDS. JELLYFISH.

narration: Most of your siblings are gone before the first week is over.
scene: A calendar showing week 1 with most egg dots crossed out
label: WEEK 1

narration: You do the only thing a baby anglerfish can do. You drift.
scene: Tiny larva drifting with the current, doing nothing
label: DRIFT

narration: You eat what's smaller than you.
scene: Tiny larva eating an even tinier speck
label: EAT SMALLER

narration: And you hope the bigger things miss.
scene: A big fish swimming past, missing the tiny larva
label: HOPE THEY MISS

narration: Then, if you're still alive, you do the stupidest thing a surface animal can do.
scene: Tiny larva looking down into darker water with a worried face
label: STUPID IDEA

narration: You sink.
scene: Tiny larva falling downward with motion lines
label: SINK

narration: Down past the last of the sunlight.
scene: A fading sun at the top, larva sinking below it
label: LAST LIGHT

narration: Down into a place with a name that is not a metaphor. The midnight zone.
scene: Simple signpost in empty water reading midnight zone, larva arriving
label: MIDNIGHT ZONE

narration: There is no sun here. Ever.
scene: A crossed-out sun icon above empty water
label: NO SUN. EVER.

narration: The water is just above freezing.
scene: A thermometer next to a shivering little fish
label: JUST ABOVE FREEZING

narration: The pressure would fold a human like paper.
scene: A stick-figure human folded like a paper airplane
label: HUMAN ORIGAMI

narration: Food is whatever dead stuff rains down from above. Scientists call it marine snow.
scene: Little specks falling like snow, a tiny fish looking up
label: MARINE SNOW

narration: You call it dinner. If you're lucky.
scene: Tiny fish with a fork waiting under falling specks
label: DINNER?

narration: Most animals down here starve.
scene: Empty plates floating in the water
label: MOST STARVE

narration: You are about to become two completely different animals, depending on one thing.
scene: One tiny larva splitting into two arrows, left and right
label: TWO ANIMALS

narration: Whether you hatched female, or male.
scene: Two doors labeled female and male
label: FEMALE OR MALE

narration: And if you hatched male — I am sorry.
scene: A tiny male fish with a sad face and a tiny apology card
label: I AM SORRY

narration: Let's start with the girls. They have it better. Relatively.
scene: A female anglerfish with a small trophy that says relatively
label: RELATIVELY

narration: If you're female, you grow a fishing rod out of your forehead.
scene: Female anglerfish with a simple pole growing from her forehead
label: FISHING ROD

narration: It is a spine that used to be a fin, now bent forward like a pole.
scene: Diagram of a fin turning into a bent fishing pole
label: USED TO BE A FIN

narration: At the end of it is a bulb. And inside the bulb, bacteria live rent-free.
scene: Close-up of a round lure bulb with tiny smiling bacteria inside
label: RENT-FREE

narration: They make light. The only light you will ever see.
scene: The lure glowing as a flat yellow circle, nothing else lit
label: THE ONLY LIGHT

narration: You sit in the dark, and you wave it.
scene: Female anglerfish sitting still, waving her lure
label: WAVE IT

narration: A tiny glowing lantern in an ocean of nothing.
scene: Tiny lantern lure in a huge empty frame of water
label: OCEAN OF NOTHING

narration: Hungry things swim up to look.
scene: A curious fish swimming toward the glowing lure
label: THEY LOOK

narration: That is the last decision they ever make.
scene: The curious fish about to be eaten, shocked face
label: LAST DECISION

narration: Your mouth is a trap door. Your teeth are needles.
scene: Huge simple mouth with needle teeth like a trap door
label: TRAP DOOR

narration: Your stomach is a suitcase. You can swallow things bigger than you.
scene: Anglerfish with a suitcase-shaped belly swallowing a bigger fish
label: SUITCASE STOMACH

narration: You don't chase. Chasing wastes energy, and energy is the one thing you don't have.
scene: Anglerfish on a couch holding her lure, not chasing
label: DON'T CHASE

narration: You wait. Days. Weeks. Sometimes months between meals.
scene: A calendar with many empty days and one circled dinner
label: MONTHS BETWEEN MEALS

narration: When something finally bites, you don't chew. You inhale.
scene: Anglerfish vacuuming a fish into her mouth in one gulp
label: INHALE

narration: Your jaws unhinge. Your belly swells like a balloon.
scene: Anglerfish with unhinged jaws and a round balloon belly
label: BALLOON BELLY

narration: You look pregnant. You're not. You're just full.
scene: Round anglerfish with a sign that says just full
label: JUST FULL

narration: Life as a female anglerfish is sitting in a cave of water, holding a lamp, hoping dinner is stupid.
scene: Anglerfish holding a lamp, waiting, looking bored
label: HOPE DINNER IS STUPID

narration: It works. You grow. You get rounder, uglier, and harder to kill.
scene: Three sizes of female anglerfish getting rounder
label: ROUNDER. UGLIER.

narration: You might live for years down here.
scene: A simple cake with a few candles next to the anglerfish
label: YEARS

narration: But there is one problem even a lamp and a suitcase stomach can't solve.
scene: Anglerfish looking worried, lamp and suitcase not helping
label: ONE PROBLEM

narration: Finding a boyfriend. In the dark. In an ocean the size of a planet.
scene: Tiny lonely hearts floating in a huge empty ocean
label: FINDING A BOYFRIEND

narration: If you're male, you do not get the lamp.
scene: Tiny male fish with a crossed-out lamp
label: NO LAMP

narration: You do not get the jaws. You do not get the suitcase stomach.
scene: Tiny male beside a crossed-out big mouth and crossed-out suitcase
label: NO JAWS. NO SUITCASE.

narration: You stay tiny. In some species, she is sixty times your size.
scene: Tiny male next to a huge female, a label 60x
label: 60 TIMES YOUR SIZE

narration: You are a few centimeters long. She is a monster.
scene: A tiny ruler next to the male, the female filling the rest of the frame
label: A FEW CM

narration: Your entire adult body is basically a nose.
scene: Tiny male fish that is mostly a huge nose
label: BASICALLY A NOSE

narration: Huge nostrils. A brain built to smell one thing.
scene: Close-up of giant nostrils on a tiny fish
label: HUGE NOSTRILS

narration: A female. Her pheromones. In the largest habitat on Earth.
scene: Tiny male sniffing dotted scent lines in empty water
label: SMELL HER

narration: You cannot hunt. After you grow up, some of you never eat again.
scene: Tiny male looking at food he cannot eat, empty plate
label: NEVER EAT AGAIN

narration: You have enough fat to last a little while. That's your clock.
scene: Tiny male with a ticking clock on his belly
label: THE CLOCK

narration: You are a lottery ticket with fins.
scene: Tiny male with lottery numbers on his fins
label: LOTTERY TICKET

narration: You swim. You smell. You hope.
scene: Tiny male swimming with dotted smell lines, hopeful face
label: SWIM. SMELL. HOPE.

narration: There is no map. There is no light. There is no second chance.
scene: Tiny male holding a blank map in the dark
label: NO MAP

narration: Most of you never find her.
scene: A huge crowd of tiny males, almost all with X marks
label: MOST NEVER

narration: You burn your last calorie in the dark, a few centimeters long.
scene: Tiny exhausted male with an empty fuel gauge
label: LAST CALORIE

narration: You die having never seen another of your kind.
scene: Tiny male alone, eyes closed, empty water
label: NEVER SAW ANYONE

narration: That is the normal ending. That is what usually happens.
scene: A simple stamp that says the normal ending
label: THE NORMAL ENDING

narration: But suppose you get lucky.
scene: Tiny male with a lucky four-leaf clover
label: SUPPOSE YOU GET LUCKY

narration: You smell her. You follow. You see a glow.
scene: Tiny male following dotted lines toward a yellow glow
label: A GLOW

narration: There she is. A fish the size of a nightmare, with a lantern on her face.
scene: Huge female anglerfish with a lantern lure, tiny male staring
label: THERE SHE IS

narration: This is the best day of your life. It is also the last day you are a fish.
scene: Tiny male looking happy then worried, a calendar that says last day
label: LAST DAY AS A FISH

narration: You bite her belly. You do not let go.
scene: Tiny male biting the side of the huge female
label: YOU BITE

narration: Your teeth lock in. Your skin starts to melt into hers.
scene: Tiny male's skin joining the female's side
label: SKIN MELTS IN

narration: This is not a metaphor.
scene: A stamp that says not a metaphor
label: NOT A METAPHOR

narration: Your tissues fuse. Your blood vessels hook up to hers.
scene: Simple doodle of two blood-vessel tubes connecting
label: HOOKED UP

narration: You are now on her bloodstream. She is feeding you.
scene: Tiny male attached, a food arrow going from her to him
label: SHE FEEDS YOU

narration: You will never swim again.
scene: Tiny attached male with crossed-out swimming fins
label: NEVER SWIM AGAIN

narration: Your eyes dissolve. You don't need them.
scene: Tiny male's eyes fading, X over them
label: EYES DISSOLVE

narration: Your stomach withers. You don't need that either.
scene: Tiny stomach shrinking to nothing
label: STOMACH GOES

narration: Your fins go. Your guts go. What's left of your brain shrinks.
scene: Tiny male becoming a smaller lump, leftover parts falling off
label: SHRINKING

narration: You become a pair of testes with a leftover tail.
scene: A tiny lump with a leftover tail hanging off the female
label: A LEFTOVER TAIL

narration: Scientists have a polite name for this. Sexual parasitism.
scene: A scientist stick figure labeling the lump sexual parasitism
label: SEXUAL PARASITISM

narration: You are not a husband. You are a spare part.
scene: Tiny lump next to a toolbox labeled spare parts
label: SPARE PART

narration: She might already have six of you hanging off her.
scene: Female anglerfish with six tiny male lumps attached
label: SIX OF YOU

narration: Little lumps. Former boys. Now just plumbing.
scene: Six lumps with little name tags that say former boys
label: FORMER BOYS

narration: In return, you give her sperm whenever she wants it.
scene: A tiny vending machine on her side labeled sperm on demand
label: ON DEMAND

narration: She never has to find a male again. She already glued them on.
scene: Female with glued-on males and a glue bottle
label: GLUED ON

narration: This only works because her body doesn't reject you.
scene: Female body with a welcome mat under the tiny male
label: NO REJECTION

narration: Most animals would treat a fused stranger as a disease.
scene: A normal fish with an immune shield kicking a stranger away
label: ANYONE ELSE WOULD

narration: Anglerfish deleted that part of their immune system.
scene: A delete key erasing an immune-system icon
label: DELETED

narration: They turned off the alarm so the roommate could move in.
scene: An alarm clock switched off, tiny male moving in with a suitcase
label: ALARM OFF

narration: When she's ready, she lays another jelly raft of eggs.
scene: Female releasing a jelly raft of eggs
label: ANOTHER RAFT

narration: Tens of thousands of them. They float up, toward the sun you will never see again.
scene: Egg raft rising toward a tiny sun, female staying below
label: FLOATING UP

narration: The raft drifts. The eggs hatch. The cycle starts over.
scene: A circle of icons: raft, hatch, sink, fuse
label: THE CYCLE

narration: A few of those babies will sink. Almost none will make it.
scene: Thousands of dots, only one or two surviving
label: ALMOST NONE

narration: If they're female, they grow a lamp and wait.
scene: Baby female growing a tiny lamp
label: GIRLS WAIT

narration: If they're male, they grow a nose and pray.
scene: Baby male with a huge nose, praying
label: BOYS PRAY

narration: You, the original you, are still up there on her side.
scene: The original tiny lump still attached, waving weakly
label: STILL THERE

narration: Not thinking. Not hunting. Not even really being a fish.
scene: The lump with crossed-out brain, crossed-out hunt, crossed-out fish
label: NOT A FISH

narration: You found the only girl in a thousand miles of black water.
scene: A tiny heart between the lump and the huge female
label: THE ONLY GIRL

narration: And the price was everything that made you you.
scene: A price tag covering the tiny male
label: THE PRICE

narration: As far as endings go, it could be worse.
scene: The lump shrugging
label: COULD BE WORSE

narration: You don't have to hunt. You don't have to see. You don't have to be alone.
scene: Three crossed-out icons: hunt, eyes, lonely stick figure
label: NO HUNT. NO EYES. NOT ALONE.

narration: You just have to stop being a person. Sorry. A fish.
scene: A tiny apology note that says sorry, a fish
label: SORRY. A FISH.

narration: This is the most successful dating strategy in the largest habitat on Earth.
scene: A trophy that says dating strategy, next to a huge empty ocean
label: BEST WORST DATE

narration: You didn't choose it. Evolution chose it, fifty million years ago, when your family moved into the dark.
scene: A simple timeline arrow marked 50 million years
label: 50 MILLION YEARS AGO

narration: The lamp. The nose. The fusion. The missing immune system.
scene: Four icons in a row: lamp, nose, fuse, deleted shield
label: THE KIT

narration: All of it, so two animals could find each other once, and never lose each other again.
scene: Female and tiny attached male with a small lock
label: NEVER LOSE EACH OTHER

narration: Next time you see that nightmare fish with a light on its head —
scene: A person looking at an anglerfish drawing
label: NEXT TIME

narration: Look closer. The tiny lump on her side? That used to be someone.
scene: A zoom arrow on the tiny lump on her side
label: LOOK CLOSER

narration: He won.
scene: Tiny leftover-tail lump with a small winner flag
label: HE WON

narration: Thanks for watching. If you enjoyed this, consider subscribing.
scene: Anglerfish pointing at a subscribe button
label: SUBSCRIBE

narration: And remember: in the deep sea, love is not a feeling.
scene: A heart icon with a crossed-out feeling face
label: NOT A FEELING

narration: It's a medical procedure.
scene: A tiny operating-room doodle on the female's side
label: A MEDICAL PROCEDURE

narration: See you in the next one. There's an animal that has it even worse.
scene: Anglerfish pointing off-screen to a mystery silhouette
label: NEXT TIME
